newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bank bad debts rose 14 pct in September - BoI.
newsitem.headline: Italy bank bad debts rose 14 pct in September - BoI.

text.p: Italian bank bad debts rose 14.3 percent year-on-year in September to 119.10 trillion lire from 118.37 trillion lire in August, the Bank of Italy said.
The central bank said overall bad debts in August had shown a 15.2 percent year-on-year increase.

Just for banks holding short-term deposits, accounting for all high street banks, bad debts totalled 102.35 trillion lire in September, a rise of 16.5 percent on September 1995, the latest Bank of Italy data showed.
